create_DensePoseCheckpointer: create a DensePoseCheckpointer instance to save and load model checkpoints with HRNet weight support
load_checkpoint_with_DensePoseCheckpoint: load a model checkpoint file using DensePoseCheckpointer to restore DensePose model weights
rename_HRNet_weights: rename HRNet pretrained weights to match DensePose backbone naming convention for compatibility
detect_and_rename_HRNet: detect HRNet weights by key count and rename them with backbone.bottom_up prefix
